summary: Kern County, CA lookout; a 1938 Bakersfield Californian item names a lookout man at the Jasmine station; firelookout.org lists it as gone, location undetermined.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by firelookout.org, which shows the location as undetermined

events.note: Gus Richardson appointed to act as lookout man at the Jasmine station (Bakersfield Californian item dated August 16, 1938)

evidence.supports: name shown as Jasmin on the page header
name also appears as Jasmine in the 1938 item
1938 appointment of Gus Richardson as lookout man at the Jasmine station
evidence.quote: Gus Richardson, former assistant at the Kern county fire station in McFarland, has been appointed to act as lookout man at the Jasmine station.

evidence.supports: location shown as undetermined, county Kern

notes_for_editor: Record coordinates 35.74278, -119.14389 have no source in the pages read. firelookout.org shows latitude as Undetermined with no longitude, so the coordinates need checking before use. The record name Jasmin matches the page header; the 1938 item and the page URL use Jasmine. The listing gives the type as Unknown. No NHLR or FFLOS record is cached for this site, and the guessed firetower.org and nhlr.org URLs returned 404. The sources give one 1938 staffing item and a status line, so the story is shorter than the 120-word guide floor.
